name: The Dickie Show
overview: From the wonderful world of Smoggie Queens, Dickie hosts a one-of-a-kind chat show from a makeshift studio tucked away in Mam’s garage. With a lineup of celebrity guests and plenty of unexpected surprises, it’s a chat show experience they won’t forget.
